# 📈 StockMarket 
## Ultimate Player-Driven Economy Plugin 💰  
**By PrabhatPie**

Bring a **realistic stock trading system** to your Minecraft server where players can invest, trade, and build their financial empire! Prices dynamically change based on **player activity, volatility, and market events**.

---

## 🚀 Overview
StockMarket transforms normal Minecraft items into **tradable stocks**.

Players can:
- 📊 Buy & Sell Shares  
- 💹 Track Profit & Loss  
- 💰 Earn Dividends  
- 🏆 Compete on Leaderboards  

---

## 🔥 Features

### 📊 Dynamic Price System
- Prices change based on buy/sell demand  
- Configurable volatility (LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH)  
- Floor & ceiling protection  
- Smart async calculations  

### 💼 Portfolio System
- Track shares, average price, profit/loss  
- Real-time net worth calculation  
- Passive **dividend income**  

### ⚡ Market Events
- 🚀 SURGE (price boost)  
- 💥 CRASH (price drop)  
- 🔥 FRENZY (double trading activity)  

### 📰 Market News
- Auto broadcast major price changes  
- Admin custom headlines  
- Discord webhook support  

### 🖥️ GUI System
- 📦 Market Browser  
- 🔍 Item Detail View  
- 💼 Portfolio Menu  

### 🏦 Economy Support
- Full **Vault integration**  

---

## 👤 Member Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|--------|------------|-----------|
| `/stocks` | Open stock market GUI | `stockmarket.use` |
| `/stocktop` | View top investors leaderboard | `stockmarket.use` |

---

## 👑 Admin Commands

| Command | Description | Permission |
|--------|------------|-----------|
| `/stockadmin setprice <item> <price>` | Set stock price manually | `stockmarket.admin` |
| `/stockadmin event <item> <SURGE\|CRASH> <minutes>` | Trigger market event | `stockmarket.admin` |
| `/stockadmin reset <item>` | Reset stock to default | `stockmarket.admin` |
| `/stockadmin blacklist <item>` | Remove item from market | `stockmarket.admin` |
| `/stockadmin headline <message>` | Broadcast custom news | `stockmarket.admin` |
| `/stockadmin setblock` | Set physical exchange block | `stockmarket.admin` |

---

## 🔐 Permissions

### 🎮 Player Permissions
- `stockmarket.use` → Access market & leaderboard  

### 🛠️ Admin Permissions
- `stockmarket.admin` → Full control over market  

---

## 🏛️ Special Feature
- Place a **Stock Exchange Block** in the world  
- Players can **right-click to open the market GUI**  

---

## 🧠 Gameplay Strategy
- Buy low, sell high 📉📈  
- React to events ⚡  
- Build long-term investments 💼  

---

## ⚙️ Perfect For
✔ Survival Servers  
✔ Economy SMPs  
✔ Roleplay Servers  
✔ Competitive Communities  

---

## 💬 Final Words
StockMarket adds **depth, strategy, and excitement** to your server economy.

✨ *Trade smart. Invest smarter. Become the richest player!* 💰📊
